controls.criterion: Session authentication, recovery and logout reject expired/revoked sessions in authenticated browser/API tests
controls.evidence_required: Authenticated run logs, replayable negative session fixtures

controls.criterion: Every mandatory read and mutation is authorized server-side by active membership and role, including deny tests
controls.evidence_required: Role/permission matrix plus negative API integration evidence

controls.criterion: Tenant A cannot read, mutate, export or download tenant B records via API, RLS and Storage
controls.evidence_required: Tenant A/B authenticated runtime and SQL/RLS/Storage results

controls.criterion: Privileged SQL functions, elevated writers, files and webhooks are restricted to intended principals
controls.evidence_required: Production grants/policy readback and unauthorized-invocation tests

controls.criterion: Secrets never reach client bundles or logs; TLS and at-rest protection are appropriately configured
controls.evidence_required: Secret scanner, deployed configuration attestation, transport/storage checks

controls.criterion: No known unaccepted material high/critical issue in committed flows; privileged actions have durable audit events
controls.evidence_required: Risk register, vulnerability dispositions, event replay and audit outputs

controls.criterion: A legitimate user signs up, authenticates and creates/joins the intended workspace
controls.evidence_required: Authenticated signup/onboarding E2E and durable DB readback

controls.criterion: AI inventory create/view/update and risk assessment persist with correct tenant and ownership
controls.evidence_required: Authenticated E2E plus persisted record and isolation evidence

controls.criterion: Governance workflow records accountable owner, decision, timestamps, review state and supporting evidence
controls.evidence_required: Multi-role approval/deny E2E and durable audit trail

controls.criterion: Evidence uploads/downloads, audit trail, mandatory reporting and document export work with access controls
controls.evidence_required: Authenticated browser/API tests, generated file inspection and data readback

controls.criterion: Administration, retention/deletion/export and privacy request workflows fulfill the published offering
controls.evidence_required: Role-specific E2E, data deletion/retention and export evidence

controls.criterion: Navigation and actual product contracts match what is marketed; incomplete optional flows are not sold as complete
controls.evidence_required: Release-scoped product route inventory and marketing/contract mismatch review

controls.criterion: Publicly committed plans map to existing correctly configured Stripe prices and intended access limits
controls.evidence_required: Redacted Stripe product/price IDs and offer-to-entitlement mapping
controls.accepted_by: G1 Engineering, owner-authorized acceptance (independent Stripe LIVE + Vercel provider readbacks; governed PR integration pending)

controls.criterion: Signed Stripe TEST webhooks reject invalid signatures and replay/duplicates safely
controls.evidence_required: Genuine Stripe test event, webhook delivery IDs and idempotency readback

controls.criterion: A genuine test Checkout creates and persists the expected organization entitlement in isolated QA
controls.evidence_required: Exact-SHA Stripe TEST event linked to QA durable DB state and app entitlement

controls.criterion: Plan changes, nonpayment and cancellation converge on durable, safe subscription states
controls.evidence_required: Genuine Stripe TEST lifecycle events plus authenticated UI/backend assertions

controls.criterion: Access checks and billing modifications are authorized server-side; customer cannot self-grant a paid tier
controls.evidence_required: Negative API tests and tenant-isolated entitlement query evidence

controls.criterion: An ordered, reconciled and reviewed migration manifest bootstraps isolated QA without version collisions
controls.evidence_required: Approved replay manifest, migration hashes, SQL replay log and schema parity check
controls.notes: BLOCKED: exact live comparison shows 137 production migration versions and 7 isolated-QA versions, with zero overlap. Full canonical replay parity is not established.

controls.criterion: Concurrent membership changes and usage quotas preserve critical invariants or fail atomically
controls.evidence_required: Native PostgreSQL concurrent-session tests and repeatable invariant queries

controls.criterion: High-value decisions, audit-chain and billing state survive transaction failure/retry without untracked divergence
controls.evidence_required: Rollback/atomicity negative cases, constraint assertions and audit-chain validation

controls.criterion: A bounded isolated restoration proves DB and relevant Auth/Storage/application recovery boundaries
controls.evidence_required: Restore transcript, data integrity diff, Auth/Storage scope and recovery limitation log

controls.criterion: Production migrations, RLS/FORCE RLS, RPC grants and data boundaries match the approved release
controls.evidence_required: Version-scoped provider SQL readback, function ACL and grant tests
controls.notes: NOT_VERIFIED: provider readback reports 115/115 public tables RLS+FORCE RLS in production and QA, with no anon/authenticated table privileges on the 33 no-policy tables. Function ACL, service_role, storage, schema parity and tenant-isolation evidence remain open.

controls.criterion: Mandatory application/unit/integration and security regression suites complete without failing checks
controls.evidence_required: Exact-SHA test logs and results for full required suites

controls.criterion: Real authenticated browser tests cover core user journeys and tenant A/B access denies
controls.evidence_required: Exact-SHA Playwright logs, artifacts sanitized of private data

controls.criterion: Billing plus error, retries, persistence, cancellations and degraded behavior pass application/runtime E2E
controls.evidence_required: Exact-SHA runtime/Stripe sandbox QA report

controls.criterion: Test source SHA, build, QA environment and deployed tested artifact are traceable; no synthetic substitution
controls.evidence_required: Signed or otherwise independently verifiable check IDs, exact-SHA provenance

controls.criterion: The current production deployment is READY, its exact SHA is known and release acceptance uses that SHA
controls.evidence_required: Live Vercel deployment ID/commit SHA and domain assignment verification
controls.accepted_by: G1 Engineering, owner-authorized acceptance (provider evidence review, pending governed PR integration)
controls.notes: Source PASS preserved, but current Vercel readback reports production SHA 70d3545f... while current GitHub main is 6b54e899...; governed reconciliation required before treating as current-main proof.

controls.criterion: Protected or equivalently controlled merges/releases require approved review, trustworthy checks and explicit release decision
controls.evidence_required: Readback of native rule enforcement or documented audited equivalent controls

controls.criterion: Public critical routes and an authenticated core workflow pass deployment-specific smoke checks
controls.evidence_required: Runtime smoke results and health/endpoints with exact deployment identity

controls.criterion: Production monitoring, alert routing, incident response and support contact operate and are documented
controls.evidence_required: Provider alert check, incident drill, runbook and support route

controls.criterion: A governed rollback/recovery exercise verifies safe restore of a known-good release without customer-data mutation
controls.evidence_required: Isolated/staged rehearsal log, rollback target SHA and acceptance record

controls.criterion: QA, live, preview and production configuration and credentials stay isolated and fail closed
controls.evidence_required: Environment provenance matrix, safe negative-cross-environment tests

controls.criterion: Operator/contracting entity and software rights are identified and supported by appropriate corporate evidence
controls.evidence_required: Authoritative supplier/ownership records, reviewed identity statement

controls.criterion: Product terms, privacy notice and applicable DPA are accurate, accessible and reviewed for the target service
controls.evidence_required: Versioned terms/privacy/DPA, legal approver identity, effective dates

controls.criterion: Subprocessors, retention/deletion, transfers and GDPR role allocation match operating reality
controls.evidence_required: Verified vendor list and data flow, retention schedule and legal/privacy sign-off

controls.criterion: AI Act and independent-assurance marketing statements are scoped, current and do not imply false certification
controls.evidence_required: Fact/legal review checklist and approved claim inventory

controls.criterion: Customer-ready security questionnaire, disclosure/contact route, support and incident commitments are truthful
controls.evidence_required: Evidence-indexed procurement packet, tested contact path and approved commitments

controls.criterion: All legal obligations applicable to the offered scope have a documented qualified acceptance or bounded unresolved decision
controls.evidence_required: Applicable-obligation matrix, legal reviewer conclusions and approved exceptions
